answer: A Zora mint returns a receipt, and the creator-fee proof shows the fee went to the real creator. Receipts are verified on-chain, and the fee split is checked each epoch. The violet signal separates the two cases at a glance: A farm needs 192 separate mint receipts, since one receipt cannot cover 192 mints. The island ledger records each payment, the wander window resets the board, and 192 fakes never beat one honest agent on price.
